snippet.title: Mayday: Air Disaster
snippet.description:
Learn exactly how every air disaster happened, and why. Every case is reconstructed clue by clue, built for viewers who want to understand the failure, not just watch it unfold.

Investigating the unthinkable.

Revealing the dark truth that aviation safety improves one crash at a time, Mayday: Air Disaster investigates legendary aviation disasters to find out what went wrong and why. Based on cockpit voice recorders, accident reports, and eyewitness accounts, every episode also features interviews, gripping reenactments, and state-of-the-art CGI.

From maintenance issues and dangerous cargo to extreme weather, investigators need to find the exact cause to ensure it never happens again. They owe it to the victims, the survivors, and their families to examine every clue and ultimately crack the case.

snippet.title: Fredrik Sträng
snippet.description:
Welcome to my channel — Raw Places on Earth. The Deepest Human Stories.

Here, I take you to the world’s rare and sacred places — the summits, jungles, deserts, and forgotten corners of Earth — and introduce you to explorers, scientists, and seekers who redefine human limits.

Expect cinematic adventures, stories from the edge, and practical insights that will fuel your next expedition — on the mountain or within yourself.

I’m Fredrik Sträng — alpinist, filmmaker, motivational speaker, and photographer.
I’ve stood on the world’s highest peaks — seven 8,000-meter mountains, the 7 Summits on each continent (a Guinness World Record) — and 19 Himalayan expeditions. I’ve produced documentaries for TV4 and SVT, written two books, and appeared in the award-winning film The Summit.

Subscribe — and join me on the climb.
Because the summit isn’t the goal — it’s the journey that transforms us.

Regards, Fredrik Sträng
